title: First numeric state shard of the strict 20-draw prime-seed orbit
index_rule: candidate first output state x=4*i+1, 0<=i<2^46; next 19 bytes use successive POSIX LCG states
screen: ANSI SHA-1 coefficient exists, is not forbidden, and -27/c is a quadratic residue mod the fixed P-256 prime
controls: For each of ten published prime-field seeds, reconstruct its first output state from the reported timestamp and 1-based block ordinal and compare all 20 bytes
output: Every root-admitting seed in this shard, with state index, seed, c and b; counts of all other precheck outcomes
non_claim: No group orders are computed by this stage; a root-admitting coefficient is not an accepted prime-order curve. The shard is 2^-30 of the strict orbit for this one fixed field.
